tree.heading: Appropriate congressional committees
tree.text: The term “appropriate congressional committees” means the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate and the Committee on International Relations of the House of Representatives.

tree.heading: Countries of the South Caucasus and Central Asia
tree.text: The term “countries of the South Caucasus and Central Asia” means Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kazakstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan.

notes.heading: Change of Name
notes.text: Committee on International Relations of House of Representatives changed to Committee on Foreign Affairs of House of Representatives by House Resolution No. 6, One Hundred Tenth Congress, Jan. 5, 2007.

ancestors.heading: Support for the Economic and Political Independence of the Countries of the South Caucasus and Central Asia
